## Requirements: standalone Nession Pages MVP

**Parent:** #1782. Deliver Phase 1 only, without claiming that Phase 2 full Issue→PR→Agent exact-SHA drilldown or Phase 3 independent orphan integrity audit is complete.

### Scope / boundaries
Build a public project home and read-only AI engineering observatory, completely isolated under root `pages/`. It must have its **own typography, themes, design tokens, components, CSS, navigation and build**, never import or copy the authenticated product `web/`. The public artifact is generated from a pinned read-only `metrics` checkout, sanitized AI Role Registry and GitHub API snapshots. Unknown observations are N/A, never guessed. A public orphan ref does not imply trusted integrity.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A dependency-independent root `pages/` project builds an accessible static public site, with its own design system and no `web/` imports or copied UI assets.
- [x] SC-02 Home explains Nession and the AI collaboration workflow, with independent mobile navigation and direct hash-based deep links.
- [x] SC-03 Agents shows role registry plus observed 7d runs/tokens/tool calls/cost coverage without equating workflow Agents to runtime node Agents or inventing per-Agent token costs.
- [x] SC-04 Repository and Collaboration render sanitized public snapshot metrics and open GitHub Issues/PRs with clear main SHA/generation metadata and truthful absent data.
- [x] SC-05 Evidence view only exposes branch-presence metadata; no raw Run Store data, private sessions, host identifiers or false append-only claims.
- [x] SC-06 Build-time projection has strict read-only, versioned, bounded allowlists and deterministic positive/negative fixtures; Pages and product Web builds stay independent.
- [ ] SC-07 A real source-aligned Playwright Acceptance Case verifies standalone public Home/Agents/Work/Repository/Evidence navigation, safe untrusted text, responsive/deep link behavior and source/absence states at the exact merged main SHA; required E2E IDs must already pass against PR HEAD.

| SC-01 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; workflow: CI / Pages run 38661442758 completed success head_sha 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c (.github/workflows/ci-pages.yml); file: pages/package.json: standalone scripts build/check/test with zero npm dependencies under root pages/; file: pages/styles.css: independent :root design tokens and DM Sans/Instrument Serif typography (no web/ asset paths); test: pages/tests/project.test.mjs: independent UI must not import product Web styles/components/tokens; summary: Root pages/ builds as a static site with its own design system; CI Pages succeeded at PR SHA and tests forbid web/ imports. |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; file: pages/app.js renderHome(): Nession continuity narrative plus 5-step COLLABORATION LOOP diagram and workflow lede copy; file: pages/index.html + app.js: hash routes #/, #/agents, #/work with hashchange-driven render() for deep links; file: pages/styles.css @media (max-width:1100px/600px): topbar flex-wrap, full-width overflow navigation for mobile; file: pages/index.html: skip link, lang=en, aria-label Main navigation; summary: Home explains Nession and the AI collaboration workflow; hash routing and responsive nav CSS implement mobile navigation and deep links. |
| SC-03 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; file: pages/app.js renderAgents(): explicit disclaimer that registered workflow Agents are not runtime node Agents; aggregate cost not allocated per Agent; file: pages/scripts/project.mjs rosterFrom(): role registry with observed_7d run counts only when by_agent_id has records; cost_7d null when observed_runs is 0; test: pages/tests/project.test.mjs: per Agent observations do not inherit global token/cost totals (no tokens on roster entries); summary: Agents view shows registry plus 7d aggregate runs/tokens/tools/cost with N/A for missing data and no per-Agent token/cost invention. |
| SC-04 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; file: pages/app.js renderRepository()/renderWork(): sanitized metrics grid, main commit slice, generation dates, and open Issues/PR lists with unavailable empty states; file: pages/scripts/project.mjs: safeText/safeSha/canonIssue allowlists; source.main_sha, source.metrics_sha, issues_status/pulls_status in projection; test: pages/tests/project.test.mjs: strict sanitized/public schema only; unknown source is unavailable, never zero; summary: Repository and Collaboration render bounded public snapshot metrics and GitHub Issues/PRs with SHA/generation metadata and truthful absent/unavailable handling. |
| SC-05 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; file: pages/app.js renderEvidence(): orphan stores show name/purpose/ref state only; disclaimers against append-only claims and live Run Store data; file: pages/scripts/project.mjs evidence.record(): present/missing/unavailable + sha/url only; validateProjection rejects private-field key patterns in exported JSON; test: pages/tests/project.test.mjs: unverified branch identities never yield present status for invalid sha; summary: Evidence exposes branch-presence metadata only, with explicit boundaries and no raw Run Store or private session fields in the projection. |
| SC-06 | Pass | run 38661914956; ref 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c; source agent-cursor; file: pages/scripts/project.mjs: schema_version 1, bounded slices (issues/pulls 12, roster 40), roles allowlist, read-only makeProjection/validateProjection; test: pages/tests/project.test.mjs: positive sanitization fixture plus negative unknown-source and tampered-ref fixtures; file: pages/scripts/build.mjs: build-time-only GitHub/metrics inputs; copies pages-owned index.html/styles.css/app.js to dist (no web/ build coupling); workflow: CI / Pages run 38661442758 success at 97864f8c3a9a6982bd451e01ad3a8e2853597e4c independent of web/ CI; summary: Build-time projection is versioned, allowlisted, and covered by deterministic unit fixtures; Pages build and product web remain separate packages. |
| SC-07 | Pending | Post-merge main-SHA Playwright Case required; not eligible for pre-merge Pass |
